about: How «Probar esta versión» starts a REQ version of pictures (bt_verify_servers). The owner's local .env.local, with the database switched to the REQ-021 test database and the web pointed at the version's own ai-api. ${NAME} comes from the owner's secret files at start; {port:x} is the port actually used. Every link opens the version already signed in as a real test account (auto_login, D-205): `mint` inserts an account_sessions row for the chosen test+<role>@pictures.test account and exits 3 when it does not exist; `seed` then creates the missing accounts (pictures' own scrypt parameters read from the version's src/lib/seguridad/scrypt.ts, password PICTURES_TEST_PASSWORD from the owner's secrets file, never printed) and mint runs again (D-231). The older test+<role>@req021.test rows (seeded by hand 2026-10-30) are kept. Backup of the previous recipe: verify-servers.json.bak-20261030.

servers.name: ai-api
servers.run: APP_ENV=development DATABASE_URL= RERANK_MODEL_WARMUP=false uv run --frozen --directory services/ai-api uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port {port}

auto_login.mint: node -e 'const {Pool}=require("pg");const c=require("crypto");(async()=>{const p=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,max:1});try{const a=await p.query("SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE lower(email)=lower($1) AND status=$2",[process.env.BT_LOGIN_ACCOUNT,"active"]);if(!a.rowCount){console.error("no existe la cuenta de prueba "+process.env.BT_LOGIN_ACCOUNT);process.exitCode=3;return}let v="";try{v=(require("fs").readFileSync("src/lib/cuentas/aviso-datos.ts","utf8").match(/VERSION_AVISO_DATOS\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/)||[])[1]||""}catch(e){}if(v){await p.query("UPDATE accounts SET data_notice_version=$1, data_notice_accepted_at=now() WHERE id=$2",[v,a.rows[0].id])}const t=c.randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");const now=new Date();await p.query("INSERT INTO account_sessions (id,account_id,token_hash,created_at,expires_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5)",[c.randomUUID(),a.rows[0].id,c.createHash("sha256").update(t).digest(),now,new Date(now.getTime()+864e5)]);process.stdout.write(t)}finally{await p.end()}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1})'

pw=process.env.BT_TEST_PASSWORD||"";if(pw.length<8){console.error("la contraseña de prueba tiene menos de 8 caracteres");process.exitCode=2;return}const src=fs.readFileSync("src/lib/seguridad/scrypt.ts","utf8");const k=n=>Number(((src.match(new RegExp("const "+n+"\\s*=\\s*([0-9_]+)"))||[])[1]||"").replace(/_/g,""));const N=k("COST"),r=k("BLOCK_SIZE"),P=k("PARALLELIZATION"),L=k("KEY_LENGTH");if(!(N&&r&&P&&L)){console.error("no encuentro los parámetros scrypt de la app (src/lib/seguridad/scrypt.ts)");process.exitCode=1;return}let v="";try{v=(fs.readFileSync("src/lib/cuentas/aviso-datos.ts","utf8").match(/VERSION_AVISO_DATOS\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"/)||[])[1]||""}catch(e){}const p=new email=String(a.email).trim().toLocaleLowerCase("en-US");if(!(await db.query("SELECT 1 FROM account_roles WHERE id=$1",[a.role])).rowCount)throw new Error("no existe el rol "+a.role+" en la base de accounts (id,email,status,password_hash,data_notice_version,data_notice_accepted_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)",[id,email,"active",hash,v||null,v?new Date():null]);row={rows:[{id:id}]};console.log("creada "+email)}await db.query("INSERT INTO account_role_assignments (account_id,role_id) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",[row.rows[0].id,a.role])}await db.query("COMMIT")}catch(e){await db.query("ROLLBACK");throw e}finally{db.release();await p.end()}})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1})'
